stem.en: How is Startup India linked to Atmanirbhar Bharat?

text.en: Startup India is the new name given to Atmanirbhar Bharat in 2047.
Atmanirbhar Bharat is a startup valued at over 1 billion dollars.
Startup India is a scheme that supports Atmanirbhar Bharat.
Startup India asks Indian startups to buy more goods from abroad.

explanation.en: Startup India is one of the government's schemes to promote entrepreneurship, and it supports the vision of Atmanirbhar Bharat: a self-reliant India that makes more at home and depends less on imports.

hints.en: One is a scheme, and the other is a national policy framework.
